=== does /en/locations render a map (leaflet)? ===

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== map/geocoding modules live ==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev drush cget core.extension module 2>&1 | grep -iE "openculturas_map|geocoder|leaflet" ; echo "=== does /en/locations render a map (leaflet)? ==="; curl -s "http://openculturas.ddev.site/en/locations" | grep -oiE "leaflet|openstreetmap|map" | sort | uniq -c | head
